name: H2 Nails & Spa
greeting: Hi! 💅 Welcome to H2 Nails & Spa. I can help with services, prices, hours, or booking your visit. What can I do for you?

kb.location: 5311 Yonge St, North York (Yonge & Finch area)

faqs.a: Walk-ins are welcome, but booking ahead guarantees your spot — especially evenings and weekends.
Most manicures take 30–45 min; pedicures and full sets 60–75 min.
Gel is cured polish with a glossy finish (2–3 wks). Dip powder is more durable (3–4 wks) and great for natural-nail strength. Happy to recommend based on your nails!
Yes! Gift cards are available in any amount — just ask in-store or call us.
There's parking available at the plaza, plus street parking nearby.
